Discord: https://discord.gg/2pPmuyr4pP


In this video, I build a complete sponsorship and brand-deal management app from scratch using **MonkeyCode**, a free and open-source AI coding platform that runs directly in your browser.

Instead of setting up a local development environment, installing dependencies manually, or configuring API keys, MonkeyCode gives each development task its own cloud environment where the AI agent can actually write code, install dependencies, run the project, test it, fix errors, and generate a live preview.

For this tutorial, we build **CreatorFlow** — a complete dashboard for creators that includes:

• Sponsorship and campaign management
• Revenue tracking
• Payment status
• Campaign deadlines
• Search and filtering
• Deadline Command Center
• Automatic dashboard updates
• Desktop and mobile responsive design
• Real working interactions

I also show how I iterate on the first version using follow-up prompts, switch between supported AI models, test the project inside MonkeyCode's cloud environment, and finally submit the finished application to the **MonkeyCode AI Gallery**.

According to the campaign information, MonkeyCode currently offers:

🔥 Free — **30M tokens/day**
⚡ Pro — **100M tokens/day**
🚀 Ultra — **300M tokens/day**
